subject.title: ACP session identity stuck in "pending" state after gateway restart storm, causing messages to be unrouted to bound ACP agent

question: Should ACP restart recovery stay status/liveness-confirmed and persistent-only, rather than resolving pending ensure-sourced identities solely because stable IDs are present?
rationale: The bug is credible, but the available fixes change persisted ACP identity and runtime recovery semantics across configured channel bindings, stale process records, and one-shot sessions.

options.title: Status-Backed Recovery
options.body: Keep ensure IDs provisional, recover or relaunch persistent sessions through runtime status/liveness checks, and require configured-channel restart proof.

options.title: Resolve Pending IDs
options.body: Treat pending identities with stable IDs as resolved, accepting that ensure-sourced IDs become authoritative before event or status confirmation.

options.title: Defer Until Replacement PR
options.body: Wait for a narrow replacement of the closed warm-restore PR before deciding whether this issue is fully covered.

recommendation.title: Status-Backed Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep ensure IDs provisional, recover or relaunch persistent sessions through runtime status/liveness checks, and require configured-channel restart proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the ACP control-plane split, runtime-handle ensure/cache, startup identity reconcile, and acp-core identity helpers.
